name: Kirameku Shunkan
source:
Shiki Tatsuya is touring on his motorcycle when he suddenly becomes dizzy and has an accident. 

It just so happens that the hospital he was admitted to, Taisei Hospital, has established an in-hospital class for a long-term patients who are students at Kashiwagi Academy. Tatsuya's injury will take three months to heal completely, so he too is temporarily transferred to this class.

Tatsuya is shocked to see his classmates and fellow patients living so optimistically, despite struggling with their illnesses inside of the hospital. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1547]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
志木达也骑着摩托车游览时突然感到头晕并发生了事故。

恰巧他入院的医院大成医院为柏木学园的一名长期患者开设了住院班。达也的伤需要三个月才能完全痊愈，所以他也暂时转入这个班级。

达也很震惊地看到他的同学和病友们尽管在医院里与病魔作斗争，但仍过着如此乐观的生活。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1547]Getchu.com[/url]]
